status: runtime authority for five pilot groups and five paired vowel places; next ten groups remain reviewed expansion records but are not wired as Garden 2 markers

scheme.name: Letters and Sounds teaching order, adapted to 44 phonemes
notes: x and qu are taught later as two-phoneme spellings /k/+/s/ and /k/+/w/, not as phoneme groups.
The /zh/ phoneme is explicit; voiced/unvoiced th and long/short oo are separate.
UK MFA is canonical. CMUdict is stored only as a non-canonical cross-check.
The five vowel letters each have reviewed short and long side groups; the 44-phoneme groups remain the underlying sound inventory.
Long u means British /juː/ here. The /uː/ oo sound in moon remains the separate oo-long group.
